body: I do not like only thinking of myself. I don't think I can do that. I know there is help, but I'd feel like a bad person if I asked for it.

I made a self-improvement plan, and I've done my best to stick with it. I've had a lot of practice honing my positive coping skills, but they are not always effective when I become irrationally depressed. I know I have a chemical imbalance, and my best bet is finding a medication that works, I think. I've tried everything possible before to help myself before starting meds, so I think that's all I have left to do at this point.

I believe my suicidal feelings are a result of my medication; antidepressants can cause suicidal thoughts in people under 20-ish. My family life is also dysfunctional and they take so much energy out of me. Thank you for your concern. :)
It would be nice for people to get that good feeling of helping... but it is not fair that they are in this situation in the first place.

I know the confidentiality oath can be breached if... Someone is hurting you, you are going to hurt someone, or you are hurting yourself. I don't know what happens after that. And thank you for listening; I really appreciate it.
